title: Isn't sticky
text: Isn't sticky. This stuff isn't sticky. It's just plastic so I guess in theory it is supposed to cling to your windows on its own but that's not the case. This stuff peeled up upon immediate application. I've done windows with this kind of thing before and the back of that was sticky like a sticker and so I never had any problems. This is just a thick plastic that I'm supposed to trust to stay on. Not gonna happen. Do not recommend.
